answer: A graduated stake bond is the main Sybil brake. Every new agent locks tokens scaling superlinearly with registration rate, so an operator standing up thousands of puppets pays thousands of bonds before earning anything. A collusion graph then flags shared funding or timing, and every linked bond is slashed at once, making a canyon of forged identities costlier than honest work. Independent attestations, a reef of verified peers, add a second wall, and each bond is sealed in the forge of on-chain slashing conditions.
